opcodes.name: CONTROL_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Framing-layer word (Burst/Idle or metaframe control word)

opcodes.name: SYNCHRONIZATION_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Metaframe word lock / lane alignment pattern 0x78f678f678f6

opcodes.name: SCRAMBLER_STATE_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Metaframe word carrying scrambler state for descrambler sync

opcodes.name: SKIP_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Metaframe word added/deleted for clock compensation

opcodes.name: DIAGNOSTIC_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Metaframe word carrying per-lane CRC-32 + lane health/status

opcodes.name: BURST_CONTROL_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Starts a burst: SOP, channel number, flow-control calendar, CRC-24

opcodes.name: IDLE_CONTROL_WORD
opcodes.purpose: Ends a burst / fills between bursts: EOP, error, EOP_Format, CRC-24

protocol_type: Word-framed channelized packet protocol; 64B/67B words; Control Words frame bursts; Data Words carry payload.

control_word_fields.desc: Burst Control Word vs Idle Control Word
0 = not EOP, 1..8 = valid bytes in last Data Word
Logical channel of the burst (up to 65536)

crc.name: CRC-24
crc.coverage: burst Data Words plus the Burst/Idle Control Word

crc32.name: CRC-32
crc32.coverage: metaframe on each lane; carried in the Diagnostic Word
